summary: Full backend + frontend regression for the luxury ring builder refresh (18k-only, moval/old-mine/accent-shape, new bands, hidden-halo, Colombian Emerald default stone, canvas default = Photo, material_request). 20/20 pytest backend tests PASS (new /app/backend/tests/test_ring_builder.py rewritten against the new catalog). Frontend /build on 390x844 verified: canvas defaults to Photo (canvas-mode-photo selected, builder-render-photo visible from cache), all new testIDs present (style-option-hidden-halo, option-shape-moval, option-shape-old-mine, option-band-polished, option-band-three-quarter-pave, option-band-infinity, option-accent_shape-round, option-accent_shape-pear), default addon-option-ring-colombian-emerald present, request-other-material-button reveals material-request-input, switching to canvas-mode-live mounts ring-3d-viewer with all 5 controls (zoom-in/out, spin-toggle, reset-view, fullscreen). The exact spec example from the review request (ring/halo/rose-gold/size 7/ring-colombian-emerald + {carat:1.5, band:three-quarter-pave, shape:moval, accent_shape:pear}) was reproduced in the UI and the builder-total-price read **$12,145** — matches the review target exactly, and the backend /api/price returns total=12145 with lines 18k gold 4.0 g=386, Setting & craftsmanship=1170, Accent diamonds 0.62 ct=964, Colombian Emerald=9625. Earrings regression PASS: default addon-option-ear-colombian-emerald present. Only pre-existing benign WebGL 'ReadPixels GPU stall' warning observed; no pageerrors.

react_native_issues.issue: Pre-existing Chrome 'GPU stall due to ReadPixels' warning on first canvas mount (web-only software GL). Non-blocking, carried from iter_4. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/ring3d/ring-viewer.tsx (snapshot path).

critical_code_review_comments: catalog_data.py:102 — KARAT is an intentionally empty list. The server never exposes a 'karat' option group (confirmed by test_ring_option_groups). Consider deleting the dead KARAT variable to keep the module tidy.

server.py:65 — DesignSpec.options is Dict[str,str], so options.material_request = free-text 'Platinum please' is accepted as-is and simply ignored by compute_breakdown (no karat/material_request group lookup). This matches the review request ('extra key options.material_request is accepted'). Confirmed by test_price_accepts_material_request_extra.
server.py:92-104 — attach() populates .image URLs for setting/shape/carat/band/accent_shape by looking up db.option_images; absent keys simply have no 'image' field, which is correct behaviour.
catalog_data.py:189 — ADDONS list order drives the UI order; verified ring-colombian-emerald is first for both ring-* and ear-* via test_ring_stones_order and test_earring_stones_order.
server.py:140-141 — grams label format `f"18k gold · {grams:.1f} g"` matches the review spec ('18k gold 4.0 g (386)'). ✓
design-canvas.tsx:35 — initial mode state is 'photo' (default canvas view = Photo), matching the review request. ✓
